principle: Verification status and decision authority state are separate dimensions.

states.description: Production action is explicitly permitted within a separately established authority scope.
Only a bounded subset of actions is permitted under explicit constraints.
The artifact may be verified, but no production action is permitted.
The system must not act because the available evidence is insufficient or epistemically uncertain.
Action is temporarily suspended because an operational or governance condition remains unresolved.
Action is prohibited because a known mandatory governance or control violation exists.

hard_rules: A technically valid artifact does not automatically grant permission to act
A mandatory BLOCK condition cannot be masked by aggregate scoring
UNKNOWN or unresolved evidence cannot increase authority
